_how_to_use: Copy this file to budget/data/config.json (git ignores that folder) and replace the placeholder numbers with yours. Percentages are whole numbers: 6 means 6%.

split._how_to_use: Shared costs. joint_accounts: words from the joint card or account names. household_categories: bills from your own accounts that are shared. partner_pays_monthly: shared bills your partner pays from his own accounts (not visible here). i_pay_joint_card: true if you pay the whole joint card bill, so its charges are split as they happen. exclude_categories: categories kept out of the monthly split (e.g. a trip settled separately with the owe command). partner_payments_manual: payments from your partner that never reached a linked account, as {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": 0, "note": ""}.
